name: neon-catcher
description: Neon Catcher V7.2 Pre-Release: campaña de diez niveles, munición inicial, cometa animado, PWA y proyecto iOS verificable.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:content && npm run build:native-bridge && npm run build:web
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test:static && npm run test:architecture
scripts.test:content: node --test tests/content-expansion.test.mjs tests/content-assets.test.mjs tests/procedural-runtime.test.mjs tests/content-legacy-integration.test.mjs tests/classic-scout.test.mjs tests/journey-demo.test.mjs tests/journey-legacy-integration.test.mjs tests/modular-ship.test.mjs tests/ship-hangar.test.mjs
